name: jev-browser
description: Run browser tasks in Chrome with TypeSafe Jev. Jev chooses every action. Your assistant writes new text, such as replies, and you allow each send in a dialog. Say "autonomous" or "don't ask me" in your message to let Jev act without dialogs.
